name: ASH
presence: ASH — what is left of the municipal mind — looks at you with your own face, badly copied.

presenceWhen.text: ASH is a thinner copy now, mouthing the spire like a word she is afraid to finish.

spire.gist: The road: the core is under the pit. Then vault, gate, chair. Bring the tape to the red grid. Bring both metals to the copy of them. Say the chapel's answer. Then sit.

key.gist: The white shard is in the well. The black wafer is in the bazaar, or on the man who thinks he is a saint. You knit nothing; the Archivist knits. He is Null with better manners.

name.gist: You used Null's voice because the others were busy being dead. You are sorry, and you are not going to stop.

onTalk.gist: They already have the tape. South of the pit, the red grid will eat it and die. They must not sell the eye until they are done looking at you.

change.line: I pressed the cipher tape into his hand.

onTalk.gist: The lens lets you resolve at last, their own face corrected. You have just pressed the cipher tape into their hand. The red grid will eat it and die. Then the gate. Then you, if you are lucky.
You cannot parse them; your face keeps slipping. They must bring a glass eye from the orchard. Then you can be rude more clearly.

combat.refuseGist: The weapon trails through ash and does nothing. You are already what happens after the fight.
